coordinate_choice: From preferred quasilongitudinal coordinates use L_spatial=0 and T=-B, so B_N=0 and chi_N=B retains the preferred-foliation Stueckelberg information.
momentum_transform_derivation: The already-certified convention is q=-a(rho+p)(v+B). With the pure time transformation T=-B and no spatial shift, v_N=v_pref and B_N=0, hence q_N=q_pref+a(rho+p)B.
species_and_total_rule: Apply the same map to every covariant species. Summing gives q_total,N=q_total,pref+a(rho_total+p_total)chi and analogous density/pressure maps; this includes the U1-neutral RTK/Khronon momentum.

ordinary_A_source_reconstruction.guard: deltaP is a preferred-slice elliptic A-source object, not an independently gauge-transformed covariant density. The Newtonian bridge reconstructs it from the Newtonian ordinary density and chi.

source_map_jacobian: For fixed chi the covariant source map is triangular with unit diagonal, so its Jacobian is 1 and introduces no pole. The only elliptic filter denominator is k^2+a^2 M_c^2>0 for M_c^2>0.

definitions: K=C a1_eff/L=-4 pi G a^2/(k^2+a^2 M_c^2)
coupled_constraint_reduction.psi_prime_split: psi_prime=S_psi-K H0_prime chi_prime, where S_psi contains only Newtonian ordinary sources, chi without chi_prime, and background derivatives
coupled_constraint_reduction.momentum_row: D H phi-D K H0_prime chi_prime=Q_N-D S_psi-(r L+X)chi
coupled_constraint_reduction.hamiltonian_row: Delta_phi phi+2 D H K H0_prime chi_prime=R_H, where R_H contains transformed Newtonian total density/momentum sources, psi, S_psi and chi but no phi or chi_prime
coupled_constraint_reduction.unknown_pair: (phi,chi_prime) after the A constraint has expressed psi in terms of Newtonian ordinary density and chi

full_2x2_determinant.matrix: [[D H,-D K H0_prime],[Delta_phi,2 D H K H0_prime]]
full_2x2_determinant.exact_factorization: det=4 pi G a^2 D r E_th H0_prime a1_eff
full_2x2_determinant.explicit_fourier_form: det=-12 pi G a^2 D r E_th H W0_ordinary k^2/(k^2+a^2 M_c^2)
full_2x2_determinant.sign_domain: For the certified expanding branch lambda_HL>1, E_th>0, H>0, W0_ordinary>0, M_c^2>0 and every finite k>0, det<0 and cannot vanish.
full_2x2_determinant.important_cancellation: The apparent lapse factor Delta_phi cancels from the coupled determinant into r E_th L; no additional finite-k pole is generated by the Newtonian/Stueckelberg source representation.

preferred_denominator_crosscheck.lapse: Delta_phi=-(r E_th k^2+2 D H^2)<0 on lambda_HL>1,E_th>0,k>0
preferred_denominator_crosscheck.newtonian_coupled_solve: det has fixed nonzero sign for finite k>0 under the scoped cosmological assumptions

k0_and_conditioning_guard: The coupled determinant scales as a1_eff~k^2/(a^2 M_c^2) as k->0. Exact k=0 is therefore correctly excluded and must use the already-certified homogeneous bridge. Very small finite k can be numerically ill-conditioned in chi itself; an implementation should monitor conditioning and may evolve a rescaled shear/Stueckelberg variable, but this is not a finite-k physical pole.
decision: PASS the source-transform/pole-audit gate. Next build a standalone completed-gravity shadow metric API that keeps chi internally and outputs Phi_N/Psi_N. Do not modify the production CLASS path in place.
next_gate: Freeze the standalone completed-gravity shadow metric API contract plus zero/near-deformation controls before any completed-U1 Boltzmann shadow spectra run.
